featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an outstanding experience with Anmol Jewellers during a recent trip to Mumbai. Komal and Bhabika looked after us from start to finish, and they were exceptional. I needed two custom wedding bands, one ladies and one gents, as well as a diamond engagement ring. I arrived in Mumbai with the designs, and Anmol created all three pieces within about four weeks. The final result was exactly as drawn and even better than I expected.

They sourced a high quality diamond for the engagement ring at an excellent price. It was noticeably better in both price and quality than what we were shown elsewhere, including at Tashniq and Popley’s. The team were proactive and rang their suppliers while we were there so we could compare options on the spot. As a foreigner without an Indian card, I also appreciated that they happily accommodated a bank transfer as the payment method.

Komal and Bhabika were consistently kind, attentive and relaxed. They offered food and drinks, took their time with us, and never pushed for a sale. That was a real contrast to some of the other stores we visited. When the rings were ready, I was taken to the staff room to inspect the GIA certificate and the diamond itself. The craftsmanship was excellent, and the rings matched the original designs perfectly. Anmol even charged less than the initial estimate because the final pieces required less gold, which we thought was very honest.

Thanks to Anmol, we now have a beautifully matched custom ring set, high quality stones and workmanship, and a very fair price. They also have a wide range of other stunning jewellery if you are looking for something more elaborate. I would recommend Anmol to anyone wanting beautiful pieces and genuinely great service.

Jewellery Care Tips to Make Your Pieces Last Longer

Jewellery is more than an accessory it is an investment in style and memories. To keep your pieces looking beautiful for years, it is important to care for them properly. Simple daily habits and cleaning techniques can make a big difference in how long your jewellery lasts.

Always store your jewellery in a clean dry place. Keep each piece separate to avoid scratching and tangling. After wearing, gently wipe your jewellery with a soft cloth to remove sweat perfumes and dust. For pieces with stones and beads, be careful with water and chemicals as these can damage the finish.

Regularly check clasps and settings to make sure stones are secure. For deeper cleaning use mild soap and warm water and pat dry immediately. When not wearing your favourite pieces avoid exposing them to lotions perfumes and sprays as these products can dull their shine.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this jewelry store. At the time of purchase, the making charges were excessively high, but I trusted their promises and proceeded with the purchase. The staff assured me that their jewelry would receive 100% valuation when sold back in the future. However, when I returned after several years to sell my jewelry, I was shocked to find that they deducted nearly 20% even on their own jewelry. This was completely different from what was promised during the purchase. The lack of transparency and inconsistency in their policies made me feel misled. Instead of honoring their commitment, they seemed focused only on maximizing their own profit. Customers should be given clear and honest information rather than assurances that are not fulfilled later. Based on my experience, the management appears more interested in making money than maintaining long-term customer trust. I would advise prospective buyers to carefully verify all buyback and valuation policies in writing before making any purchase from this store.

I would not recommend this store
